# clickerheroes.dev

> Free, browser-based tools, calculators, and guides for Clicker Heroes (the idle game by Playsaurus, current version 1.0e12). Includes a save editor, ancients and outsiders calculators, save viewers and converters, and a hero gilding chart. Independent and open source; not affiliated with Playsaurus.

Save decoding, editing, and encoding run in the browser; saves are not uploaded to the site for processing. Source code: https://github.com/magnus-allison/clicker-heroes-save-editor

## Tools

- [Save Editor](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/save-editor): Decode a Clicker Heroes save string or .save file, edit gold, rubies, Hero Souls, heroes, gilds, skins, achievements, ascensions, transcensions, outsiders, mercenaries, clan values, and custom fields, then re-encode it for import back into the game.
- [Ancients Calculator](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/ancients-calculator): Optimal ancient levels and level-up costs from an imported save, for idle, hybrid, and active builds, plus a hero soul planner.
- [Outsiders Calculator](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/outsiders-calculator): Optimal Borb, Phandoryss, Ponyboy, and Chor'gorloth levels by Ancient Souls, end-of-transcension estimates, zone breakpoints, and a transcension simulator.
- [Instakill Calculator](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/instakill-calculator): Route duration, monsters per zone, and zones per hour from Kumawakamaru, Borb, zone range, and FPS.
- [Transcension Viewer](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/transcension-viewer): Transcension and ascension history from a save, with HZE, Hero Souls, and Ancient Souls totals.
- [Mercenary Viewer](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/mercenary-viewer): Mercenary roster and lifetime mercenary and quest stats from a save.
- [Save Converter](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/save-converter): Convert saves between PC and mobile formats, with detected origin and patch number.
- [Remove Clan Data](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/remove-clan-data): Strip clan, account, and login fields from a save before sharing it.
- [Save JSON](https://clickerheroes.dev/tools/save-json): Decode a save into raw JSON, edit it by hand, and re-encode it. Built for developers.

## Guides

- [New Player Guide](https://clickerheroes.dev/guides/new-player-guide): From a fresh save to the first transcension: ascending, gilding, which ancients to buy, rubies, mercenaries, clans, and relics.
- [Hero Gilding Chart](https://clickerheroes.dev/guides/gilding-chart): Which hero to gild at every gold threshold, from The Masked Samurai through the Ace Scouts, with a gold lookup.

## Help

- [FAQ](https://clickerheroes.dev/faq): Loading and exporting saves, where the save file is on Windows and Mac, save safety, and decode errors.
- [Feedback](https://clickerheroes.dev/feedback): Bug reports and feature requests.
